subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Ajay is sitting second to the left of Nikhil. Nikhil is an immediate neighbour of both Sahil and Mahesh. Daksh is sitting second to the right of Mahesh. Mahesh is an immediate neighbour of both Indu and Nikhil. Who is sitting between Indu and Ajay?
solution: **Given**: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Ajay is sitting second to the left of Nikhil. Mahesh is an immediate neighbour of both Indu and Nikhil.
